sn22.67:1.2: nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca || ||
sn22.67:1.3: Sādhu me bhante Bhagavā saṅkhittena dhammaṃ desetu || pe || pahitatto vihareyyan ti || || 4
sn22.67:1.4: Yaṃ kho bhikkhu dukkhaṃ tatra te chando pahātabboti || ||
sn22.67:2.1: Yathā katham pana tvam bhikkhu mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena attham ājānāsīti || || 6
sn22.67:2.2: Rūpaṃ kho bhante dukkhaṃ || tatra me chando pahātabbo || ||
sn22.67:2.6: Viññāṇaṃ dukkhaṃ || tatra me chando pahātabbo || ||
sn22.67:2.7: Imassa khvāham bhante Bhagavatā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena attham ājānāmīti || 7
sn22.67:3.2: sādhu kho tvaṃ bhikkhu mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena attham ājānāsi || ||
sn22.67:3.3: Rupaṃ kho bhikkhu dukkhaṃ || tatra te chando pahātabbo ||
sn22.67:3.7: Viññāṇaṃ dukkhaṃ || tatra te chando pahātabbo || ||
sn22.67:3.8: Imassa kho bhikkhu mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena attho daṭṭhabboti || || 8-9 ||Pa || ||
sn22.67:3.9: Aññataro ca pana so bhikkhu arahataṃ ahosi || || 1-3 Sāvatthi || ||
